findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_brand_availability, audit_email_deliverability, audit_ai_search_visibility, full_launch_readiness_audit · Private data: check_brand_availability · Public sink: check_brand_availability, audit_email_deliverability, full_launch_readiness_audit · Destructive: full_launch_readiness_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_brand_availability, audit_email_deliverability, audit_ai_search_visibility, full_launch_readiness_audit · Private data: check_brand_availability · Public sink: check_brand_availability, audit_email_deliverability, full_launch_readiness_audit · Destructive: full_launch_readiness_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
